name: io.github.INo-xious/stockbit-mcp
title: Stockbit MCP
description: Indonesian exchange (IDX) via your own Stockbit account: quotes, bandarmology, charts. Unofficial.

environmentVariables.name: STOCKBIT_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: core (the default) | all | a comma-separated list of families or tool names

environmentVariables.name: STOCKBIT_TRADING
environmentVariables.description: off or paper. It can only lower the trading mode, never raise it; turning trading on is done at a terminal.

environmentVariables.name: STOCKBIT_STORE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where the token store, settings, alerts, charts and the paper ledger live. Defaults to ~/.stockbit.
